decisions.reason: As a multi-model foldable large container line in a core reusable-packaging category, it still merits keeping open despite weaker later visibility because its strategic fit is strong and the firm can continue serving demand at moderate incremental cost.

A stackable plastic crate line remains close to the firm's core offer and customer needs, so even with limited website prominence the option value of retaining it is still slightly higher than abandoning it.
After several years, the modest visibility of this more specific pallet line suggests its market value has largely been revealed and is not strong enough to justify ongoing portfolio complexity.

The spill-retention pallet was an adjacent niche experiment, and by 2022 the lack of continuing market signals means the firm would likely reallocate resources from this option to stronger core and new development opportunities.
This pallet variant appears narrower than the main product families, and with uncertainty largely resolved the firm would likely rationalize it and focus resources on broader, better-supported lines.
